name: Dynamic Serena Elite 2-Person Ultra-Low EMF Far Infrared Sauna
description: Dynamic Serena Elite 2-Person Ultra-Low EMF (Between 3-5 mg) Far Infrared Sauna (Canadian Hemlock) Want to bring the benefits of a spa into your own home? Dynamic Saunas are crafted from environmentally friendly Canadian Hemlock wood, offering both durability and a clean, modern look. Each unit features advanced Low EMF FAR infrared heating panels that provide safe, energy-efficient warmth to relax muscles, reduce stress, and promote overall wellness. Designed with versatility in mind, these saunas can be installed in almost any indoor space-whether it’s your master bath, walk-in closet, basement, or fitness room. Compact yet stylish, they blend seamlessly into your home while delivering daily comfort and long-term health benefits. With Dynamic Saunas, relaxation and rejuvenation are always within reach. Features: Ultra-low EMF - EMF between 3 to 5 mg 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels 2-person capacity 7 Dynamic Ultra Low EMF (EMF between 3-5 MG - 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels) FAR Infrared Carbon heating panels Natural Reforested Canadian Hemlock wood construction Clear Tempered glass door Interior Chromotherapy Color Lighting System + Red Light Therapy Feature Interior LED Control Panels Bluetooth and MP3 auxiliary connection with built in speakers 118F-132F is the deal temperature range, sauna can heat up to 140F Clasp together assembly Roof vent Indoor use only Ships in 2 boxes Specifications: Sauna weight: 300 lbs. Shipping weight: 370 lbs. Electrical service: 120V/15amp Non GFCI plug & play (Recommended Dedicated Outlet) Exterior dimensions (LWH): 40″ x 46″ x 75″ Interior dimensions (LWH): 36″ x 42″ x 68″ Document: View Owner's Manual
